entries.en: It is hard to achieve peace, if there is a demon, never leaving.
entries.ro: E greu să găsești pacea cât timp e un demon care nu pleacă niciodată.

entries.en: You start to fade. You have no strong roots to this world.
entries.ro: Începi să te estompezi. Nu ai rădăcini puternice în lumea asta.

entries.en: OK, I'll give it a shot.
Whatever you're selling, I ain't buying it.
Whatever you're sellin', I ain't buyin' it.
As you wish. Come back when you are ready.
entries.ro: Cum vrei. Revino când ești gata.

entries.en: I will give you a meditative braindance that will liberate your consciousness.
entries.ro: Îți dau un braindance meditativ care o să-ți elibereze conștiința.

entries.en: You can pay me however much you wish.
I'll take it for free.
[Pay] OK.
Well, in that case I'll just take it for free.
This should cut it.
Very well.
The initial techniques of meditation are best undertaken with supervision.
entries.ro: Tehnicile de început se fac mai bine sub supraveghere.

entries.en: I have been waiting for you. Would you like to learn a meditation technique?
entries.ro: Te așteptam. Vrei să înveți o tehnică de meditație?

entries.en: [Sit] Changed my mind – I'll give it a shot.
Nah, not really.
You know what? Changed my mind.
Nah, not really.
Um... hello?
You must purify yourself, regain your equilibrium. I can help you.
entries.ro: Trebuie să te purifici, să-ți regăsești echilibrul. Te pot ajuta.

entries.en: [Sit] OK, I'm listening.
In the city you are cut off from nature.
entries.ro: În oraș ești deconectată de natură.
entries.ro_m: În oraș ești deconectat de natură.

entries.en: Sure isn't no Zen garden.
You must become still – restore the bond within yourself.
entries.ro: Trebuie să te liniștești – refă legătura cu tine.

entries.en: OK, I'm listenin'.
[Stand] Nice trick.
Nice vanishing trick.
Contemplation is like the silence in the eye of the storm.
entries.ro: Contemplația e ca liniștea din ochiul furtunii.

entries.en: Let us begin – I will guide you.
You still here?
You still here...?
Sit down.
Is this a prank? Is someone recording?
Is this some kinda prank? Someone scrollin' all this?
entries.ro: E vreo farsă? Cineva dă scroll la toate astea?

entries.en: You are losing touch with yourself.
Normally, you are open to new things, but now you are afraid?
entries.ro: De obicei ești deschisă la chestii noi, da' acum ți-e frică?
entries.ro_m: De obicei ești deschis la chestii noi, da' acum ți-e frică?

entries.en: Fine – what's all this about?
Meditation.
You mean, like, bein' Zen?
Precisely.
Metal, concrete canyons, neon eyes... The filth of the world suffocates you.
entries.ro: Metal, canioane de beton, ochi de neon... Mizeria lumii te sufocă.

entries.en: You are the source. All which you must do is draw from it.
entries.ro: Tu ești sursa. Tot ce trebuie să faci e să te alimentezi din ea.

entries.en: Are you ready?
I want specifics. What's in it for me?
entries.ro: Vreau detalii. Ce câștig eu din asta?

entries.en: I want specifics. What's in it for me?
entries.ro: Vreau detalii. Ce câștig eu din asta?

entries.en: Self-fulfillment. You shall hear your voice – and only yours.
entries.ro: Autorealizare. O să-ți auzi vocea – și doar pe a ta.

entries.en: All else will become silent.
Little more specific than that...?
You cannot exile yourself from your own life.
entries.ro: Nu te poți exila din propria viață.

entries.en: I'll give it a shot, why not.
"Give me?"
You can't be doin' this just for the eddies.
entries.ro: Nu poți face asta doar pe eddies.
